以秋季花草、天然材料装饰与光影音乐，将公园打造成7个篇章的免费夜间点灯活动。设有灯笼制作等工作坊（部分需预约）及餐车。周末及节假日开放至20:30。
shinjuku-kuyakusho-dori-illumination-202: About 120,000 LEDs light up the trees along roughly 700 m of Kuyakusho-dori in this annual winter illumination. Lighting ceremony on Oct 30 from 16:30 in front of Shinjuku City Hall, with the Tokyo Fire Department Band.
第20届 新宿歌舞伎町区役所通彩灯
约12万颗LED点亮区役所通约700米行道树的冬季例行彩灯。10月30日16:30起在区役所正门前举行点灯仪式，东京消防厅乐队演奏。
kanamachi-illumination-2026: A winter illumination brightening the area around Kanamachi Station and in front of Tokyo University of Science in Katsushika. Lit daily 17:00-23:00.
灯光合作金町 金町彩灯
点亮葛饰区金町站周边及东京理科大学前等地的冬季彩灯。每天17:00至23:00点灯。
kanamachi-furusato-christmas-market-2026: A one-day Christmas market with food and goods from popular shops and regional producers, a Christmas song stage and workshops (booking required). Held at Katsushika Niijuku Mirai Park for the first time, with science classes by Tokyo University of Science students (apply in advance).
故乡·圣诞市集（灯光合作金町）
仅限一天的圣诞市集，汇集人气店铺与各地特产的美食和商品，还有圣诞歌曲舞台及工作坊（需预约）。今年首次在葛饰新宿未来公园举办，另有东京理科大学学生主讲的实验课（需提前报名）。
sensoji-hagoita-ichi-2026: A year-end tradition where stalls selling hagoita battledores line the grounds of Senso-ji. The colorful oshie hagoita, often depicting kabuki actors, are the highlight. Closes at 19:00 on the last day.
浅草寺 岁之市（羽子板市）
浅草寺境内摆满售卖羽子板摊位的年末风物诗。描绘歌舞伎演员等的华丽押绘羽子板值得一看。最后一天营业至19:00。
hibiya-art-park-2026: Flower and Light Movement: Hibiya Art Park 2026 "Timeless Phenomena"

A large-scale outdoor art installation combining flowers, light and art in Hibiya Park, with works by Takashi Kuribayashi, Rui Sasaki and Taiki Yokote. After sunset, light installations transform the park. No booking needed.
花与光运动 Hibiya Art Park 2026「Timeless Phenomena」
在日比谷公园将花、光与艺术结合的大型艺术装置展，展出栗林隆、佐々木類、横手太紀的作品。日落后灯光演出让公园焕然一新。无需预约。
otori-jinja-torinoichi-2026: Tori-no-Ichi Fair at Otori Shrine, Asakusa
The famous rake fair at Otori Shrine, said to be where Tori-no-Ichi began. In 2026 it is held on Nov 7 and Nov 19, running 24 hours from the midnight drum, with stalls selling lucky kumade rakes.
浅草鹫神社 酉之市
据说是“酉之市”发源地的鹫神社大祭。2026年在11月7日和11月19日举行，从午夜鼓声开始持续24小时，境内摆满售卖招福熊手的摊位。
sensoji-kiku-kuyoe-2026: Chrysanthemum Memorial & Golden Dragon Dance at Senso-ji

A Senso-ji tradition since the Meiji era: bring small chrysanthemums and swap them for ones offered in the main hall (about 6:30-16:00). A special chrysanthemum charm is offered only on this day, and the Golden Dragon Dance is performed at about 11:00, 14:00 and 15:00.
浅草寺 菊供养会・金龙之舞
自明治时代延续至今的浅草寺活动：带来小菊，与供奉在本堂的菊花交换带回（约6:30-16:00）。只有这天才授予“菊花御守”，金龙之舞约于11点、14点、15点在境内表演。
kyu-iwasaki-shibaniwa-tsuji-kyogen-2026: Kyogen on the Lawn at Kyu-Iwasaki-tei Gardens
Traditional kyogen comedy performed on the lawn in front of the Meiji-era Western-style mansion. Two shows at 13:00 and 15:00 (about 40 min each), no reservation needed. Moves indoors if it rains.
旧岩崎邸庭园 草坪狂言
以明治时期的洋馆为背景，在草坪庭园上演狂言。13点和15点两场（各约40分钟），当天自由观看。雨天改在洋馆1楼大餐厅。
mot-synchronic-constellation: Synchronic Constellation: Stars That Shared Their Time

An exhibition at the Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo linking artists who lived in the same era and resonated across borders and genres, like stars in a constellation. Open until 20:00 on Fridays in November.
共时的星丛——共享时代的星辰 跨越边界的艺术目光
东京都现代美术馆的企划展，将生活在同一时代、跨越国界与领域相互呼应的艺术家们像星座一样串联起来。11月的周五开放至20点。
scai-nobuko-tsuchiya-ace-of-hearts: A solo show by Nobuko Tsuchiya, known for curious sculptures built from everyday materials, at a gallery set in a former public bathhouse in Yanaka. Closed Sun, Mon and holidays.
在由谷中旧澡堂“柏汤”改建的画廊举办的土屋信子个展，她以身边材料组合出奇妙的立体作品。周日、周一及节假日休息。
atelier-uchino-koike-masanori-kaikai: A solo show by a sculptor working mainly with ceramic techniques: vivid, textured objects and works on the cycles of life and nature, in a small gallery in Ueno-Sakuragi. Live flute performance from 17:00 on the opening day (Oct 24).
造型艺术家的个展，以陶艺技法为主，展出色彩鲜艳、质感丰富的物件，以及以生命与自然循环为主题的立体和平面作品。首日24日17点起有长笛现场演奏。
azur-rose-galerie-tobira-border: A three-artist show on the theme of doors in the mind and the invisible border between inside and outside, with glass by Mayu Otsuka, mineral-based work by kopfkino and a new series by Keitaro Matsui. Closed Mon-Wed.
以心中之门和分隔内外的“看不见的边界”为主题的三人展。展出大冢麻由的玻璃作品、kopfkino与矿石对话的作品，以及柗井圭太郎的新系列。周一至周三休息。
asakura-choso-asakura-zoo-2026: A special exhibition gathering sculptor Fumio Asakura's animal sculptures, cats included, at his former studio-home in Yanaka, along with crafts featuring animals and insects from his collection. Closed Mon and Thu; a temporary closure of about a week is planned during the run.
在谷中朝仓文夫的工作室兼故居，集中展出以猫为首的朝仓动物雕塑，还有他收藏的动物、昆虫主题工艺品。周一、周四休馆，展期中预计临时休馆约一周。
ichiyo-memorial-nakarai-tosui-2026: Nakarai Tosui and Higuchi Ichiyo: 100 Years On

A special exhibition on Nakarai Tosui, Higuchi Ichiyo's fiction mentor and the man she admired, marking 100 years since his death: his life, writings and bond with Ichiyo. The museum in Ryusen is a walk from Otori Shrine.
特别展 逝世100年－师之君 半井桃水与樋口一叶
纪念半井桃水逝世100周年的特别展。介绍这位樋口一叶的小说老师、也是一叶倾心之人的生平、著作及与一叶的关系。纪念馆位于龙泉，从鹫神社可步行前往。
shodo-museum-90th-nakamura-fusetsu: Calligraphy Museum 90th Anniversary: Nakamura Fusetsu and the Museum
An anniversary show at the museum painter-calligrapher Nakamura Fusetsu opened at his Negishi home, displaying its masterpieces together with the museum's history. The second half runs from Oct 6.
书道博物馆开馆90周年纪念 中村不折与书道博物馆
画家、书法家中村不折在根岸自宅开设的书道博物馆迎来开馆90周年的企划展，一次性公开名品并介绍博物馆的历程。后期自10月6日起。
tokyo-nominoichi-2026-autumn: One of Tokyo's biggest flea markets, with 300+ vendors selling antiques, vintage clothing, used books, records and handmade crafts, plus food trucks and live stages. Sweet bean paste festival on 10/31–11/1 and wheat/bread festival on 11/2–11/3.
东京跳蚤市场’26 秋季
东京规模最大的跳蚤市场之一，300多个摊位出售古董杂货、古着、旧书、黑胶唱片和手工艺品，还有美食餐车和现场舞台。10/31–11/1有红豆馅节，11/2–11/3有小麦面包节。
akasaka-nominoichi-151: Akasaka Flea Market in ARK HILLS (151st)
Monthly flea market at Ark Hills with antique furniture and homeware, vintage clothing, jewelry and artists' crafts. Held rain or shine (cancelled in storms).
第151届 赤坂跳蚤市场 in ARK HILLS
每月第4个星期日在ARK HILLS举办的跳蚤市场，有古董家具、杂货、古着、首饰和手作工艺品。小雨照常举行，恶劣天气取消。
tokyo-nogyosai-55: About 1,000 Tokyo-grown vegetables, fruits and flowers on show at this farm produce fair. On 11/3 there is a ¥500 one-coin sale (about 3 items, numbered tickets) plus sales of Tokyo potted flowers and processed foods. Public viewing on 11/2 starts around 16:00 after judging.
第55届 东京都农业祭
展出约1,000件东京产蔬菜、水果和花卉的农产品评比会。11/3有500日元可买约3样的一枚硬币特卖（需整理券），还出售东京产盆花和加工食品。11/2评审结束后约16:00起对外开放。
tokyo-shukakusai-2026: Tokyo Metropolitan Government's food and tourism fair with local specialties from across Tokyo, food trucks with regional dishes, and local sake, shochu and craft beer. Also traditional craft demonstrations, family workshops and a footbath.
东京都主办的观光物产活动，汇集东京各地特产、地方美食餐车，以及地酒、烧酒和精酿啤酒。还有传统工艺实演、亲子工作坊和足汤。
yebisu-marche-1025: Organic and natural farmers' market held on the 2nd and 4th Sundays at Yebisu Garden Place's Chateau Plaza, with vegetables and food from farmers and producers.
每月第2、第4个星期日在惠比寿花园广场城堡广场举办的有机・自然主题农夫市集，农家和生产者带来蔬菜和食品。
yebisu-marche-1108: Organic and natural farmers' market held on the 2nd and 4th Sundays at Yebisu Garden Place's Chateau Plaza, with vegetables and food from farmers and producers.
每月第2、第4个星期日在惠比寿花园广场城堡广场举办的有机・自然主题农夫市集，农家和生产者带来蔬菜和食品。
yebisu-marche-1122: Organic and natural farmers' market held on the 2nd and 4th Sundays at Yebisu Garden Place's Chateau Plaza, with vegetables and food from farmers and producers.
每月第2、第4个星期日在惠比寿花园广场城堡广场举办的有机・自然主题农夫市集，农家和生产者带来蔬菜和食品。
tokyo-ajiwai-festa-2026: Tokyo Ajiwai Festa 2026 – TASTE of TOKYO

A Tokyo Metropolitan Government food festival across four areas (Marunouchi, Yurakucho, Hibiya, Toyosu), with food trucks, restaurant specials and markets using Tokyo-grown ingredients. Hours vary by area; held rain or shine.
东京都主办的美食节，在丸之内、有乐町、日比谷、丰洲四个区域举行，有使用东京食材的餐车、餐厅限定菜单和农产品市集。各区域营业时间不同，雨天照常举行。
ikebukuro-west-gourmet-park-2026: One of Ikebukuro's biggest food festivals, with 50 stalls of Japanese, Western and Chinese dishes and drinks, plus live stage shows and a kids' area. No reservation needed; held rain or shine.
第2届 池袋西口美食公园2026
池袋规模最大的美食节之一，50家日式、西式、中式料理和饮品摊位齐聚，还有舞台演出和儿童区。无需预约，雨天照常举行。
shibakoen-vietnam-food-fes-2026: A festival of Vietnamese food at Shiba Park, with food and shopping booths, talks on Vietnamese food culture and concerts by Vietnamese artists.
在芝公园举行的越南美食节，有越南料理和商品摊位，还有饮食文化讲座和越南艺人演唱会。
nakano-hitsuji-festa-2026: Hitsuji (Sheep) Festa 2026 in Nakano Antenna Street
The 11th edition of this sheep-themed festival, with lamb and mutton dishes, wool goods and crafts, hands-on activities and stage shows. Held rain or shine.
羊节2026 in 中野天线街
第11届以羊为主题的活动，有羊肉料理、羊毛制品和手工艺品销售，还有体验活动和舞台表演。雨天照常举行。
azabudai-yakiimo-hiroba-2026: Roasted sweet potatoes, sweet potato desserts, roasted chestnuts and Mont Blanc, with a bonfire from 15:00 and daily live music at Azabudai Hills. Sales until 19:30; may change or be canceled in rain.
在麻布台之丘售卖烤红薯、红薯甜点、糖炒栗子和蒙布朗，15点起有篝火，每天有现场演奏。红薯和栗子售卖至19:30，雨天可能变更或取消。
meguro-persimmon-hajimete-orchestra-1025: First Orchestra from Age 0: Animal Parade (Meguro Persimmon Hall)
An interactive concert by Salon Orchestra Japan playing animal-themed classics, with a waltz dance corner. Before the show, kids can play toy instruments and try the violin. Nursing room available.
0岁起的第一次管弦乐 动物大游行（目黑柿子音乐厅）
Salon Orchestra Japan演奏与动物有关的名曲的互动音乐会，还有一起跳华尔兹环节。开演前可以玩玩具乐器、体验小提琴。设有哺乳室。
shimokita-hajimete-orchestra-halloween-1: First Orchestra from Age 0: Blue Danube Halloween Special (Kitazawa Town Hall)
A Halloween edition of Salon Orchestra Japan's interactive concert, in two sessions (doors 13:30 and 15:00). Toy and sweets gifts, costumes welcome.
0岁起的第一次管弦乐 蓝色多瑙河 万圣节特别版（北泽Town Hall）
Salon Orchestra Japan互动音乐会的万圣节版，分两场（13:30、15:00开场）。赠送玩具和糖果，欢迎变装。
honjo-bigship-hajimete-orchestra-hallowe: First Orchestra from Age 0: Blue Danube Halloween Special (Honjo BIG SHIP)
A Halloween edition of Salon Orchestra Japan's interactive concert, with toy instruments, a violin try-out, toy and sweets gifts. Costumes welcome.
0岁起的第一次管弦乐 蓝色多瑙河 万圣节特别版（本所BIG SHIP）
Salon Orchestra Japan互动音乐会的万圣节版，可玩玩具乐器、体验小提琴，赠送玩具和糖果，欢迎变装。
sancha-hajimete-orchestra-winter-1121: First Orchestra from Age 0: Winter Concert (Sancha Sharenado Hall)
An interactive concert by Salon Orchestra Japan with winter favorites such as the Skaters' Waltz. Toy instruments and a violin try-out after doors open.
0岁起的第一次管弦乐 冬季音乐会（三茶Sharenado Hall）
Salon Orchestra Japan演奏《溜冰圆舞曲》等冬季名曲的互动音乐会。开场后可玩玩具乐器、体验小提琴。
imaginus-0sai-planetarium-1101: Planetarium from Age 0: Stories of the Autumn Night Sky (IMAGINUS)
A 20-minute planetarium show with an autumn sky story featuring a prince riding Pegasus. Capacity 20; tickets sold online until 10 minutes before the start.
0岁起的天象仪～秋夜星空的故事～（IMAGINUS）
约20分钟的天象仪节目，讲述骑着飞马的王子登场的秋夜星空故事。限20人，可在购票网站购买至开演前10分钟。
okubo-library-halloween-ohanashikai-2026: Halloween picture-book readings in Japanese, with a Thai-language reading also planned. Two sessions (15:30, 16:00), 6 families each, no registration.
大久保万圣节故事会（大久保图书馆）
以万圣节为主题的绘本朗读，除日语外还预定有泰语朗读。15:30和16:00两场，每场6组，无需报名。
kitashinjuku-tagengo-ohanashikai-1107: A story time with international students from Indonesia, Tunisia and Myanmar, enjoyable even if you don't understand the languages. Capacity 20, no registration.
多语言故事会 Multilingual story time（北新宿图书馆）
与来自印度尼西亚、突尼斯、缅甸的留学生一起享受的故事会，听不懂语言也能乐在其中。限20人，无需报名。
nishiochiai-library-english-halloween-20: English picture-book reading and games with Chris Minton. 10 families; apply at the counter or by phone.
英语万圣节故事会（西落合图书馆）
由Chris Minton进行英语绘本朗读和游戏。限10组，可在柜台或电话报名。
nakamachi-library-english-ehon-1024: English picture-book readings mixed with English poems and songs. Capacity 10, first come first served; apply at the counter or by phone.
英语绘本故事会（中町图书馆）
穿插英语诗歌和歌曲的英语绘本朗读。限10人，在柜台或电话按先后顺序受理。
ariake-kodomo-library-halloween-2026: Happy Halloween! Japanese & English Story Time (Ariake Children's Library)
A special Halloween story time with stories in both Japanese and English. Costumes and babies welcome. About 15 people, no registration.
Happy Halloween！日语和英语故事会（有明儿童图书馆）
万圣节当天可同时欣赏日语和英语故事的特别故事会。欢迎变装，婴儿也可参加。约15人，无需报名。
katsushika-museum-hanashobu-ten-2026: The history of Katsushika's irises, from Edo-period cultivation and Horikiri Iris Garden to exports abroad, told through ukiyo-e, postcards and old photos. Open until 21:00 on Fri/Sat (non-holidays).
特别展“葛饰区大花菖蒲展”第2期
通过浮世绘、明信片和老照片，介绍从江户时代花菖蒲栽培、堀切菖蒲园到海外出口及战后的葛饰花菖蒲历史。非节假日的周五、周六开放至21:00。
keimyoji-fudo-myoo-tokubetsu-kokai-2026: Special Viewing: Wooden Standing Fudo Myoo Statue (Important Cultural Property) at Keimyoji
A limited-time public viewing of Keimyoji Temple's wooden Fudo Myoo statue, a National Important Cultural Property, in Kameari. Also open 10:00–12:00 on Oct 26, 29 and 30.
【特别公开】国家重要文化财 木造不动明王立像（惠明寺）
限时特别公开龟有惠明寺所藏的国家重要文化财——木造不动明王立像。10/26、29、30上午10:00–12:00也开放。
takasago-ongakusai-2026: A neighborhood outdoor music festival in Takasago Kita Park, with bands and singers from 10:00, a Future Stage for performers 18 and under, and a flea market.
在高砂北公园举行的户外社区音乐节。乐队和歌手从10点起轮番登场，还有18岁以下出演的未来舞台和跳蚤市场。
mizumoto-wakate-festa-24: An autumn festival in Mizumoto Park run by Katsushika's young business owners' group, with music on the outdoor stage and more. Postponed to Nov 15 if it rains.
由葛饰年轻企业家会举办的水元公园秋季庆典，露天舞台有音乐演出等。雨天顺延至11/15。
hirai-enzotei-enraku-wakate-rakugo-2026-: Young Rakugo Performers of the Enraku Ichimonkai (Hirai Enzotei)
A 90-minute rakugo show by four young storytellers of the 5th Enraku school; the lineup changes each time. Phone reservations from Oct 16, 13:30. There is also a show on Fri Nov 27 at 19:00.
五代目圆乐一门会 青年落语会（平井圆藏亭）
五代目圆乐一门会的4位青年落语家带来的90分钟定期公演，每场演员不同。10/16 13:30起电话预约。11/27（周五）19:00另有一场。
gunsei-chorus-5th-concert-2026: A concert by Chorus Gunsei, formed by alumni of the Edogawa Children's Choir. Reserve via Instagram/X DM or email and pay at the door.
合唱队群星 第5届定期演奏会
由江户川区少年少女合唱团毕业生组成的合唱队群星举办的定期演奏会。通过Instagram、X私信或邮件预约，当天付款。
funabori-blue-sky-market-1110: Shirasagi Special Needs School and local welfare workshops sell handmade cookies, pound cake, senbei, bread, baked sweets, pottery and leather goods. Cancelled in bad weather.
Blue Sky Market（船堀站前义卖会）
都立白鹭特别支援学校和区内福利作坊出售手工曲奇、磅蛋糕、仙贝、面包、烘焙点心、陶器和皮革小物等。恶劣天气取消。
sumidagawa-open-terrace-2026: Riverside fun on the Sumida River terraces: river cruises, a mini train, a mini aquarium, a stamp rally and a pop-up library. Until 19:00 by Arakawa Yuen, until 16:00 by Miyamae Park. Ogutoberfest runs the same days.

志愿者为孩子们朗读绘本、带玩手指游戏。无需预约，当天先到先得，13:30开门。无停车场。
edogawa-bunkageijutsusai-senryu-tanka-ha: Edogawa Arts Festival: Senryu, Tanka & Haiku Exhibition

edogawa-bunkageijutsusai-yoga-2026: Edogawa Arts Festival: Autumn Yoga Festival

enzotei-rakugo-higashikasai-2026: The Enzotei rakugo show visits Higashi-Kasai Library, with the Edogawa Rakugo Study Group and others. Elementary age and up (no infants); 50 places, apply by phone or at the counter.
圆藏亭落语会 in 东葛西图书馆
平井圆藏亭的落语会来到东葛西图书馆，由江户川落语研究会等表演。小学生以上（婴幼儿不可），名额50人，电话或1楼柜台报名。
nihombashi-mitsukoshi-dai-chuoku-ten-16-: 16th 'Heart of Tokyo' Chuo City Food & Craft Fair

ginza-mitsukoshi-lovit-gourmet-festival-: Food fair from the TBS morning show 'Lovit!', held at Ginza Mitsukoshi for the first time. Part 1: Oct 28-Nov 2; Part 2: Nov 3-9. 汇集由女性首长治理的城镇的难得一见的地方美食与特产。预定有东京、山形、广岛日本酒试饮（平日17～19点，周末14～17点）。

以肉类料理餐车为主的美食节与音乐节联动活动。可提前购买优惠生啤券。雨天照常（台风等恶劣天气取消）。停车位有限，从小田急町田站步行约6分钟。

在东京巨蛋城参与店铺以1,000日元套餐（1杯饮品＋食物）逐店畅饮。中央公园草坪变身“PICNIC PARK”，可外带享用。供应时间依各店营业时间（请查看官网）。另有集章和扭蛋。未满20岁禁止饮酒。

rikugien-autumn-night-2026: Light-up of the autumn-colored Japanese garden, with new projection mapping on the storehouse and bamboo grove, matcha tea houses, and food stalls/kitchen cars. arakawa-yuen-togei-kodonburi-2026: Arakawa Yuen Autumn Pottery Class: Small Donburi Bowl

sunpearl-kodomo-haiku-de-tree-2026: Kids' Haiku Class "Haiku de Tree" at Sunpearl Arakawa

sunpearl-aramaki-shake-asobiuta-2026: Play Songs and Panel Theater with Aramaki Shake (Sunpearl Arakawa)

荒卷Shake带来游戏歌、图板剧和绘本朗读。第1场10:00主要面向0〜2岁，第2场11:00主要面向3岁以上，每场先到先得15组，需家长陪同。
yoshimoto-owarai-live-in-arakawa-2026: Yoshimoto Comedy Live in Arakawa 2026: Autumn Big-Laugh Harvest Festival
A Yoshimoto comedy show with Punk Booboo, Gakutensoku, Jelladon, Aiseki Start, Batterys, Evers and more. Doors 18:30, starts 19:00. Children 4 and under free on a lap.

tokyo-enka-live-katsushika-258-2026: Tokyo Enka Live Katsushika vol.258: Tokuma Japan Autumn Enka Festival
An autumn enka showcase of Tokuma Japan singers, including Hiroko Matsumae and others. Starts 13:30; members ¥2,700.
东京演歌Live 葛饰 vol.258～德间Japan 秋之演歌祭～
德间Japan旗下演歌歌手齐聚的「秋之演歌祭」，松前ひろ子等歌手出演。13:30开演，会员2,700日元。
edogawa-bunkacenter-kisetsu-otayori-aki-: Seasonal Letters Concert: Autumn / Stars and Night (Edogawa Cultural Center special)

季节来信音乐会 秋／星・夜（江户川区综合文化中心 闭馆期间特别公演）
江户川区综合文化中心闭馆期间举办的约1小时音乐会。女中音秋本悠希、男高音隐岐速人、钢琴木村裕平演唱《星巡之歌》《Fly Me to the Moon》等星与夜的歌曲。乘京成巴士在「鹿骨区民馆」下车，学龄前儿童不可入场。
takashimaya-nihombashi-iwate-umaimono-20: A basement food fair of regional specialties from Iwate: Maesawa beef sukiyaki bento, Sanriku seafood bento, Morioka jajamen noodles, grilled squid skewers and wild grape and aronia juices. Quantities are limited.
岩手美食巡礼（日本桥高岛屋）
在地下1楼举办的岩手县地方美食展，有前泽牛寿喜烧便当、三陆海鲜便当、盛冈炸酱面、烤鱿鱼串、山葡萄和野樱莓果汁等。数量有限，可能售罄。
isetan-shinjuku-its-my-rice-2026: it's my rice: Local Rice Dishes from Around Japan (Isetan Shinjuku)

A basement food fair of regional rice dishes from 10 shops: horse mackerel fry rice box, Kirishima's katsu-meshi, Niigata tare-katsu donburi, harako-meshi, Imabari yakibuta tamago-meshi and Yonezawa beef roast beef bowl.
it's my rice～各地的家乡饭～（伊势丹新宿店）
在地下1楼食品催事区汇集全国各地米饭料理的活动，有竹荚鱼炸饭盒、炸猪排饭、新潟酱汁炸猪排盖饭、鲑鱼亲子饭、今治烤猪肉鸡蛋饭、米泽牛烤牛肉饭等10家店。
malaysia-fair-tokyo-2026: A three-day fair with Malaysian food from food trucks, such as nasi lemak and satay, plus traditional dance on stage, batik and henna experiences and Malaysian snacks and seasonings for sale.

ginza-ginchakai-2026: Ginchakai 2026: Ginza Outdoor Tea Gathering (Autumn Ginza)

An autumn tea gathering where six tea ceremony schools and sencha masters serve tea at 12 outdoor spots along Ginza-dori, with original wagashi from Ginza shops. The beginner tea experience needs no booking. In rain, only the tea room on Ginza Mitsukoshi 9F is held.

midtown-midwinter-lounge-2026: A new outdoor lounge at MIDTOWN CHRISTMAS 2026 where you can sip champagne while watching the MIDWINTER LIGHTS bubble illumination in the garden. Open weekdays from 16:00 and weekends from 15:00 until 22:00 (last order 21:30).

A charity market selling about 7,000 items from popular brands at 70–90% off, including JIL SANDER, RICK OWENS and DRIES VAN NOTEN. For every item bought, one new garment is donated to disaster-hit areas of Kumamoto. A charity flea market runs at the same time. Closes at 15:30 on the last day.
THAT'S FASHION WEEKEND 2026 慈善时尚市集
以三至一折出售约7,000件人气品牌服装的慈善市集，参与品牌包括JIL SANDER、RICK OWENS、DRIES VAN NOTEN等。每售出一件，就向熊本受灾地区捐赠一件新衣服。同时举办慈善跳蚤市场。最后一天开放至15:30。
teshigoto-marche-kitasando-2026-11: A market by STYLINGNOTE and enté with 21 instructors and students: bread, baked sweets, sencha, accessories, goods, baby items and craft activities. 5 min walk from Kitasando Station.

positive-flea-marche-higashiginza-2026-1: A market of fortune telling, relaxation and handmade booths: kyusei kigaku, Mana cards, aroma hand treatments, fabric goods and more.
汇集占卜、放松疗愈和手作摊位的市集：九星气学、玛那卡、芳香手部护理、布艺小物等。
fruitfesta-buncasai-2026: A fruit culture festival with fruit shops, growers, processed goods and goods, plus music, talks and workshops. On the 8th from 15:00, a free Sotte Bosse live (first 60 seats, no reservation).
汇集水果专卖店、生产者、加工品和杂货的市集，还有音乐、对谈和工作坊。8日15:00起Sotte Bosse免费演出（先到60席，无需预约）。
kichinaka-marche-vol60: The 60th edition of a market on Kichijoji's Nakamichi-dori, running since 2019: candles, fabric goods, embroidery, flower arrangements, rice-flour sweets, homemade jam and more. Makers differ by day.
自2019年起在吉祥寺中道通举办的市集第60届：蜡烛、布艺、刺绣、花艺、米粉烘焙点心、手工果酱等。每天的摊主不同。
meetup-gather-aoyama-2026: An exhibition, sale and meetup by MUKU & HIBI with about 30 creators selling zines, photo books and goods. 5 min walk from Gaiemmae Station. Hours are provisional.
由MUKU & HIBI举办，约30组创作者展示并出售ZINE、写真集和周边的交流会。外苑前站步行5分钟。时间为暂定。

六本木之丘66广场的圣诞灯饰，点灯至24:00（最后一天至23:00）。
